summary: The inventory is accurate: the partition and every count re-derive from files.tsv, config.xml and the 114 Jenkinsfiles. Three rulings-page proposals cannot be carried out as written: §5 relies on podYaml templates that do not exist for most types, §2 rule 6 contradicts §13's DockerImages labels, and §14's recipe leaves a new scheduled job that never runs.

findings.summary: §5's 'templates: holds the library's sidecars' relies on podYaml templates that exist only for k8s and modern-app-toolchain; aac_tools (72 files), python, helm and iac_toolchain have none, and the page does not say so
§2 rule 6 (a generated stage computes only its parenthesised part) contradicts §13's generated 'Build <image> image' labels for DockerImages
§14's new-repo recipe has the push start every job's first build; a scheduled job has no push trigger, so its file-declared cron never registers and the job never runs
§3 (stage granularity) lists no retired variants for any option; the inventory section it cites holds them
The settled table and §11 present two unruled items as settled: J08's 'when {}' and Theme E's registry-host constant
Grounding's J19 'load' nuance, which the page drops silently, is the option the operator did not pick; recorded for P5 in plan.md
